validation_scope: Document consistency, retained requirements and package integrity only. No Android build or app test was performed.
manual_review: Discovery precedes dependent code; the early APK milestone follows closure.
Room inputs, delegated engineering, configuration, empirical checks and material owner decisions are separate.
Supplied requirements are not superseded by assistant-authored records.
Minimum ceiling/profile and basic geometric-acoustic operations have concrete contracts.
Silent/private capture, local data lifetime, explicit deletion and versioned service submission are defined.
New-project setup and authority agree across the prompt, Project instructions and CLAUDE.md.
Engineering defaults are distinct from fixed product requirements and material business inputs.
Isolated emulator tests are permitted; personal-device installation and publishing retain authorization boundaries.
The start guide requires both product asset files and distinguishes chat uploads from execution files.
Drawing dimensions/material labels are design data; profile detail and validated performance remain explicit inputs.
No unresolved product-instruction conflict needs an immediate user choice.
